name: Hurdy Gurdy Drone
description: Major-key mixolydian drone: an I-iii-IV-V7 verse resolving into a bVII-IV-I chorus. In G it is the Hurdy Gurdy Man record (G-Bm-C-D7 verse, F-C-G chorus). The major-key bVII is the hook.
source: Donovan + Mickie Most (1966-69), via Ultimate Guitar chord sheets, from Hurdy Gurdy Man
